reason: This changes partition pruning semantics in core planner code and the table partition selection path, specifically extending list-partition pruning from point predicates to non-point ranges. That is a correctness-sensitive optimizer area: a pruning mistake can silently exclude needed partitions and cause wrong results, not just plan quality changes. Even with only two main code files, the blast radius is meaningful because partition pruning sits on a central planner/table boundary and affects user-visible SQL semantics for partitioned tables.
